notes: Judge B V1 semantic review of today's 169-candidate pool. Selected 15 distinct, investable catalysts after rejecting entity/ticker mismatches, generic commentary, duplicate angles, low-quality SEO stories and weakly material events. The final mix emphasizes AI/semiconductors and major earnings while retaining retail, Canadian financials, energy, regulation and rates diversity.
